tax-four-cities:
Same $100 order. Four different tax bills.

An Ontario shop shipping goods across Canada charges:
Calgary: $5 (5% GST)
Toronto: $13 (13% HST)
Halifax: $14 (14% HST, since April 2025)
Moncton: $15 (15% HST)

For goods you deliver, the rate follows where the order goes, not where your shop sits. Provinces with their own PST have extra rules, so check before you ship there.

Send this to the friend who just started shipping across Canada.
